reason: The label command can spawn gh pr edit. It stays disarmed until FACTORY_CONTROLLER=active, FACTORY_LABELS=armed, WAKE_GITHUB_TOKEN, FACTORY_SPEND_LIMIT_CONFIRMED=yes, and FACTORY_AUTOMATIONS_SAVED=yes. Those are unset. The committed scope is inactive. authorizedDispatches is null, which also refuses a wake. Cursor Automations are not saved.

session.maxUncheckpointedMinutesIs: operating policy, not a confirmed Cursor platform limit
session.checkpointEnforcement: worker instruction only. No timer observes or enforces the interval.
session.newRun: only when continuation is unavailable, inappropriate, or the repair budget is exhausted
session.stop: immediately when the work is complete or a real blocker is recorded

budget.note: These figures are an illustration from the 2026-10-29 architecture note. They are not an authorization and not a measured Cursor price.
budget.authorizedDispatchesMeans: Null does not mean unlimited. While dispatch is active, decide refuses a wake until the ledger carries a fixed positive run count. Illustrative dollars never grant a wake. A provider-side spending limit is still unset and is required before any live worker.

labels.actor: WAKE_GITHUB_TOKEN user connected to the Cursor automation. github-actions[bot] must not be the label actor.
